changes.title: Mangione pleads guilty in federal court, leaving fate of state trial uncertain
changes.summary: Mangione has pleaded guilty to stalking charges in connection with the death of Brian Thompson, a health care executive. A separate judge will decide the future of Mangione's state trial. (Image credit: Steven Hirsch).

changes.title: Mangione could plead guilty in federal case ahead of N.Y. murder trial
changes.summary: A surprise hearing this Friday in federal court has added to speculation that Luigi Mangione could enter a plea, which could derail a state murder trial. (Image credit: Steven Hirsch).
